policy.owner_scope: GraphQL derives tenant from TenantContext and recipient from the authenticated human user's AuthContext
policy.principal_boundary: missing authentication and OAuth service principals receive the same stable user-required envelope
policy.tenant_boundary: auth and tenant context must match before module and database access
policy.module_boundary: the notifications module must be enabled before the owner unread-count query executes
policy.error_boundary: database and owner failures map to generic stable GraphQL envelopes without internal details
policy.request_boundary: the GraphQL query and native server function accept no tenant recipient or user identity
policy.transport_boundary: SSR and hydrate select native server transport while CSR and headless select GraphQL with no fallback
policy.route_boundary: the module component builds the localized inbox route through UiRouteContext::module_route_base
policy.header_boundary: the host exposes a generic ordered header_actions slot and never imports NotificationNavigation directly
policy.navigation_boundary: the action is best effort and disappears on auth module or transport failure instead of breaking the header
policy.zero_boundary: an exact zero count keeps the localized inbox link visible without a numeric badge
policy.unread_boundary: the badge count is the exact owner count and is never derived from grouped summary pages or local state
policy.storage_boundary: the header action persists no count or inbox state in local storage
policy.parity_boundary: GraphQL parity is delivered only for the navigation unread count; grouped pages open authorization and commands remain native-only
